lines.zh: 金鳞划开浑水，我巡我的河段。
lines.en: Golden scales cut the murk; this river bend is mine.

lines.zh: 河底暗流正好，顺着它滑一段。
lines.en: The undercurrent is kind today; I ride it downstream.

lines.zh: 尾鳍一摆，泥水也挡不住我。
lines.en: One flick of the tail and the muddy water cannot slow me.

lines.zh: 丛林的影子落在水面，我在下面游。
lines.en: Jungle shadow falls on the water; I swim beneath it.

lines.zh: 这片浅滩的石头我认得每一块。
lines.en: I know every stone on this shallow shelf.

lines.zh: 金光是警告，不是邀请。
lines.en: The gold flash is a warning, not an invitation.

lines.zh: 逆流而上，去上游的树根间看看。
lines.en: Upstream to the tangle of roots before the light goes.

lines.zh: 河湾的水草太密，绕开些。
lines.en: The weeds in this bend are thick; I go around.

lines.zh: 顺水漂一段，省些力气。
lines.en: Let the current carry me a while and save my strength.

lines.zh: 我贴着河床走，影子藏在泥里。
lines.en: I hug the riverbed and keep my shadow in the silt.

lines.zh: 水温刚好，像雨后的树荫。
lines.en: The water is just warm enough, like shade after rain.

lines.zh: 刚才有东西在动，去看看。
lines.en: Something moved back there; I will go and look.

lines.zh: 别踩这片沙，那是我的必经之路。
lines.en: Do not step on this sand; it is my only road.

lines.zh: 游到红树林那头，再折回来。
lines.en: I will swim to the mangroves and then turn back.

lines.zh: 我从树根下钻过去，不带泥。
lines.en: I slip under the roots without stirring mud.

lines.zh: 水面有虫子落下来，我去看看。
lines.en: Something fell on the surface. I go check.

lines.zh: 急流那一段，我侧身过。
lines.en: Through the rapids I turn sideways.

lines.zh: 我的金光在浑水里也一样亮。
lines.en: My gold still shows through muddy water.

lines.zh: 我在这儿等，等谁先动。
lines.en: I wait here to see who moves first.

lines.zh: 水面的光晃得我有点困。
lines.en: The light on the surface is making me drowsy.

lines.zh: 肚子空了，可这片水太安静。
lines.en: My belly is empty, but this water is too quiet.

lines.zh: 有只甲壳在石缝里敲。
lines.en: Something with a shell is tapping in the rocks.

lines.zh: 我不急，鱼从不急着吃饭。
lines.en: No rush; a fish never hurries a meal.

lines.zh: 那道金影是我，不是你眼花。
lines.en: That golden shape is me, not your eyes tricking you.

lines.zh: 漂着，等小鱼自己游近。
lines.en: Drifting, waiting for small fish to come near on their own.

lines.zh: 河面有落叶，闻起来是甜的。
lines.en: Leaves on the surface smell sweet as they rot.

lines.zh: 上面的鸟影，我不喜欢。
lines.en: I do not like that bird-shaped shadow above.

lines.zh: 水草在动，可能只是风。
lines.en: The weeds are moving. Probably only the wind.

lines.zh: 待在这里，鲨鱼的鼻子找不到我。
lines.en: Here, a shark's nose will not find me.

lines.zh: 喝一口水，尝尝今天的河。
lines.en: One mouthful, to taste what the river is like today.

lines.zh: 丛林的雨没停，水涨了一点。
lines.en: The jungle rain has not stopped; the river has risen.

lines.zh: 安静的时候，我数水面的涟漪。
lines.en: When it is quiet, I count the ripples on the surface.

lines.zh: 你在岸上站很久了，想下来吗。
lines.en: You have stood on the bank a long while. Coming in?

lines.zh: 两脚的东西，你的影子压到我的水了。
lines.en: Two-legged thing, your shadow lies on my water.

lines.zh: 手指伸进来我会咬。
lines.en: Fingers in the water get bitten.

lines.zh: 你身上有鱼腥味，很远就闻到了。
lines.en: You smell of fish; I caught it from far off.

lines.zh: 我盯着你，你也盯着我，公平。
lines.en: I watch you, you watch me. That is fair.

lines.zh: 河对岸还有路，你可以走那边。
lines.en: There is a path on the far bank; you may use it.

lines.zh: 你的靴子会搅浑我最爱的浅湾。
lines.en: Your boots will muddy my favourite shallow bay.

lines.zh: 金鳞亮了，说明我在认真看你。
lines.en: My scales have brightened, which means I am watching closely.

lines.zh: 要捕我就下水，别在岸上比划。
lines.en: If you mean to catch me, come down; stop gesturing.

lines.zh: 你的网我看过，织得不算密。
lines.en: I have seen your net; the weave is not very tight.

lines.zh: 谁在水里动我。
lines.en: Who dares strike me in the water?

lines.zh: 鳞片掉了一片，记你一笔。
lines.en: A scale came loose. I will remember you for it.

lines.zh: 疼，但河会替我藏起来。
lines.en: It hurts, but the river will hide me.

lines.zh: 这一下不轻，我游歪了。
lines.en: That one landed hard; I am swimming crooked.

lines.zh: 血流进水里，我得走了。
lines.en: Blood is in the water. I have to go.

lines.zh: 你打断了我的巡河。
lines.en: You interrupted my patrol of the bend.

lines.zh: 金鳞翻了起来，很难看。
lines.en: My scales have flipped up. It looks terrible.

lines.zh: 别追，受伤的鱼最凶。
lines.en: Do not follow; a wounded fish is the fiercest.

lines.zh: 我躲进石缝，你别进来。
lines.en: I am hiding in the crevice. Do not come in.

lines.zh: 这笔账，等水清了再算。
lines.en: I will settle this when the water clears.

lines.zh: 那是虫子还是饵？先绕一圈。
lines.en: Is that a bug or bait? I will circle it first.

lines.zh: 掉进水里的东西，我总要看一眼。
lines.en: Whatever falls into the water, I always take a look.

lines.zh: 这只虾还在动，应该不是陷阱。
lines.en: This shrimp is still moving; probably not a trap.

lines.zh: 你扔下来的肉块，我不客气了。
lines.en: The meat you dropped, I will not be polite about.

lines.zh: 水里的碎食，归先到的那条鱼。
lines.en: Scraps in the water belong to the fish that arrives first.

lines.zh: 香味很冲，可我的警惕更冲。
lines.en: The smell is strong, but my caution is stronger.

lines.zh: 靠近一点，就一点点。
lines.en: Closer now, just a little closer.

lines.zh: 你手上那东西还在晃，是给我的吗。
lines.en: That thing in your hand still wriggles. Is it mine?

lines.zh: 我不抢食，我只抢先机。
lines.en: I do not fight for food; I only arrive early.

lines.zh: 吃一口就走，绝不恋战。
lines.en: One bite and gone; I will not linger.

lines.zh: 撞上了，谁让你站在河心。
lines.en: We bumped. Who told you to stand mid-river?

lines.zh: 我的侧线早就警告过你。
lines.en: My lateral line warned you well in advance.

lines.zh: 别贴这么近，鳞片会被刮花。
lines.en: Do not press so close; you will scratch my scales.

lines.zh: 这一下是提醒，不是攻击。
lines.en: That nudge was a reminder, not an attack.

lines.zh: 水下太挤，各让半步。
lines.en: The water is crowded; let us each give way.

lines.zh: 你踢到我了，我的尾鳍记住了。
lines.en: You kicked me. My tail will remember that.

lines.zh: 河底的石缝才容得下我，你挡路了。
lines.en: Only that crevice fits me, and you are in it.

lines.zh: 撞了一下，你的靴子比石头软。
lines.en: One bump, and your boot is softer than stone.

lines.zh: 我们都在赶路，让开就是了。
lines.en: We are both travelling; simply step aside.

lines.zh: 金鳞碰到你，算你运气。
lines.en: My scales brushed you. Count that as luck.

lines.zh: 回到我出生的那片树根下吧。
lines.en: Let us go back to the roots where I was hatched.

lines.zh: 你的金比我的暗一点，也好看。
lines.en: Your gold is a shade duller than mine, and still lovely.

lines.zh: 雨涨水的时候，正好安家。
lines.en: With the rain raising the river, it is a good time to settle.

lines.zh: 并着游，别让鲨鱼看见两道光。
lines.en: Swim abreast; let no shark see two gleams.

lines.zh: 这片浅湾的泥软，适合产卵。
lines.en: The silt in this bay is soft, good for the eggs.

lines.zh: 我跟了你三条河湾了。
lines.en: I have followed you through three river bends.

lines.zh: 水草底下，谁也看不见我们。
lines.en: Under the weed, no one can see us.

lines.zh: 你的尾鳍节奏，我学得会。
lines.en: I can learn the rhythm of your tail.

lines.zh: 别急，先绕这片石头一圈。
lines.en: Not so fast; first circle these stones with me.

lines.zh: 从今往后，这段河我们一起巡。
lines.en: From now on we patrol this stretch together.

lines.zh: 沉底的面包屑，我收下了。
lines.en: Bread crumbs on the bottom: I will take those.

lines.zh: 这块铁片没用，但亮得好看。
lines.en: This iron scrap is useless, but it shines nicely.

lines.zh: 水底的东西，先咬一口再说。
lines.en: Things on the riverbed get one bite before judgement.

lines.zh: 你的掉落物归河，河归我。
lines.en: What you drop belongs to the river, and the river is mine.

lines.zh: 这枚硬币会沉，鱼不会。
lines.en: This coin sinks. Fish do not.

lines.zh: 我把食物藏进石缝里。
lines.en: I tuck this food into the rock crevice.

lines.zh: 有人往水里丢东西，真大方。
lines.en: Someone is throwing things into the water. Very generous.

lines.zh: 别丢垃圾，我的河不收了。
lines.en: Stop littering; my river is no longer accepting.

lines.zh: 这块肉比甲壳好嚼多了。
lines.en: This meat chews far easier than shell.

lines.zh: 沉下来的，都是我的份。
lines.en: Whatever sinks down here is my share.

lines.zh: 石头后面有条小鱼在喘。
lines.en: A small fish is gasping behind that stone.

lines.zh: 甲壳的缝隙露出来了。
lines.en: The gap in that shell has shown itself.

lines.zh: 那只虾离水草太远，机会来了。
lines.en: That shrimp strayed from the weeds. My chance.

lines.zh: 我闻到血，很淡，但够了。
lines.en: I smell blood, faint but enough.

lines.zh: 它在往浅处逃，正合我意。
lines.en: It flees into the shallows, which suits me.

lines.zh: 这条河湾里，我最大。
lines.en: In this bend, I am the largest thing.

lines.zh: 别回头看，看了也来不及。
lines.en: Do not look back; it will not help you now.

lines.zh: 目标锁定，金鳞一紧。
lines.en: Target fixed; my scales tighten with intent.

lines.zh: 它受伤了，游得歪歪扭扭。
lines.en: It is hurt and swimming crookedly.

lines.zh: 一顿饭，只需要一次判断。
lines.en: A meal takes only one good judgement.

lines.zh: 别跑，河就这么宽。
lines.en: Do not run; the river is only so wide.

lines.zh: 我跟着你的水纹，一步不落。
lines.en: I follow your wake and lose no ground.

lines.zh: 你拐弯，我抄近路。
lines.en: You turn; I take the shorter line.

lines.zh: 水草绑不住我，别指望。
lines.en: The weeds will not hold me. Do not hope for it.

lines.zh: 尾巴累了？我还没开始。
lines.en: Is your tail tired? I have not begun.

lines.zh: 你越慌，水纹越乱，越好追。
lines.en: The more you panic, the easier your wake is to follow.

lines.zh: 前面是浅滩，你只能往左。
lines.en: Shoals ahead; you can only go left.

lines.zh: 我贴近河床，从下面来。
lines.en: I stay low along the bed and come from beneath.

lines.zh: 差半条鱼身的距离。
lines.en: Half a fish-length is all that separates us.

lines.zh: 追到石桥下，就该结束了。
lines.en: Under the stone bridge, this should be over.

lines.zh: 一口，金鳞都震了一下。
lines.en: One bite, hard enough to rattle my own scales.

lines.zh: 牙不算多，够用就行。
lines.en: I have no surplus of teeth; enough is enough.

lines.zh: 我的牙一合就不放。
lines.en: Once my teeth close, they stay.

lines.zh: 你该感谢我只咬了一口。
lines.en: Be glad I only bit once.

lines.zh: 甲壳碎了，里面的肉是甜的。
lines.en: The shell cracked, and the meat inside is sweet.

lines.zh: 水花溅起来，遮住了我的牙。
lines.en: The splash hides my teeth for a moment.

lines.zh: 别挣扎，挣扎只会撕得更开。
lines.en: Do not struggle; struggling only tears it wider.

lines.zh: 这一口是河教我的。
lines.en: The river taught me this bite.

lines.zh: 你的血在水里散开，很快。
lines.en: Your blood spreads through the water quickly.

lines.zh: 咬完就退，鲨鱼会闻味而来。
lines.en: Bite, then withdraw; sharks will follow the scent.

lines.zh: 雨林的水，第一口就很暖。
lines.en: Jungle water: warm from the very first mouthful.

lines.zh: 我从树根之间游出来。
lines.en: I slip out from between the mangrove roots.

lines.zh: 这条河还没有主人，现在有了。
lines.en: This river had no master. Now it does.

lines.zh: 水温合适，我就在这儿落脚。
lines.en: The temperature suits me; I will settle here.

lines.zh: 上游下来的泥，把水染成茶色。
lines.en: Silt from upstream has dyed the water tea-brown.

lines.zh: 一条鱼，一段河，够了。
lines.en: One fish, one stretch of river. Enough.

lines.zh: 我出生时也听见这样的雨声。
lines.en: I heard rain like this when I hatched.

lines.zh: 别惊动水面，我刚到。
lines.en: Do not stir the surface; I have only just arrived.

lines.zh: 金鳞在新水里格外显眼。
lines.en: My scales stand out brightly in unfamiliar water.

lines.zh: 热带河流的味道，我记得。
lines.en: I remember the taste of a tropical river.

lines.zh: 水在烧？这不可能。
lines.en: The water is burning? That cannot be.

lines.zh: 从瀑布上摔下来，鳞都麻了。
lines.en: Fell down a waterfall; every scale is numb.

lines.zh: 鱼也会溺水，说出去谁信。
lines.en: A fish can drown too. Who would believe it?

lines.zh: 河底炸开，泥把我埋住了。
lines.en: The riverbed burst, and mud buried me.

lines.zh: 一支箭插进水里，擦过我的背。
lines.en: An arrow pierced the water and grazed my back.

lines.zh: 这水里有一股不属于河的味道。
lines.en: There is a flavour here that is not the river's.

lines.zh: 三天没吃到甲壳，牙都钝了。
lines.en: Three days without shell, and my teeth have dulled.

lines.zh: 雷劈进河里，整条河都亮了。
lines.en: Lightning struck the river; the whole channel lit up.

lines.zh: 河没有了，只剩下黑。
lines.en: The river is gone. Only black remains.
